450872397aef314c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة القسي العالمية للمقاولات عن فني صيانة مبانٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة خطط الصيانة الدورية، وتحديد المواد اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذ الأعمال، بالإضافة إلى كيل الأعمال المنجزة وإعداد المطالبات المالية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة تفاصيل خطة الصيانة الدورية لمختلف الأبنية، وتحديد العيوب الفنية، ومناقشة طرق معالجتها مع المهندس المختص. إعداد قوائم بالمواد والأدوات والمعدات والعمال المطلوبين لتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة المختلفة. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة، والتحقق من مطابقة الأعمال المنفذة للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. توضيح تفاصيل المخططات للمرؤوسين، ومتابعة دوام فرق العمل المختلفة، ورفع تقارير دورية حول الأعمال المنجزة. كيل الأعمال المنجزة، وحساب كمياتها وتدقيقها، وإعداد المطالبات المالية بالتنسيق مع محاسب الكميات، وتسليم الأعمال لجهة الإشراف. المهام التشغيلية يتضمن الدور متابعة دقيقة لتفاصيل خطط الصيانة، بدءاً من تحديد الاحتياجات والموارد، وصولاً إلى الإشراف على التنفيذ وضمان الجودة. كما يشمل الدور مسؤولية إعداد المطالبات المالية للأعمال المنجزة بدقة ووفقاً للمعايير المحددة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال صيانة المباني. القدرة على دراسة المخططات الفنية وتحديد العيوب. مهارات جيدة في إعداد قوائم المواد والمعدات وتقدير الاحتياجات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، وتتطلب العمل ضمن فريق متخصص في صيانة المباني لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة وفعالية. التقديم إذا كنت تمتلك الخبرة والمؤهلات المطلوبة، ندعوك للتقديم على هذا الدور ضمن فريق شركة القسي العالمية للمقاولات.

450e9b9066d5c6fd.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تيرا سيرفيسز عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على تنمية قاعدة العملاء وتسويق خدمات الشركة في مجالات توفير القوى العاملة، التشغيل، والصيانة. يتولى أخصائي المبيعات مسؤولية إدارة دورة المبيعات الكاملة، من البحث عن العملاء المحتملين وحتى إتمام التعاقد. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية البحث عن عملاء جدد والتواصل معهم بشكل فعال. زيارة الشركات والجهات المستهدفة لتقديم خدمات الشركة والتعريف بها. تحديد احتياجات العملاء وتقديم العروض والحلول المناسبة التي تلبي متطلباتهم. إعداد عروض الأسعار ومتابعتها لضمان التقدم في عملية البيع. التفاوض مع العملاء وإتمام العقود بنجاح. متابعة العملاء الحاليين وبناء علاقات عمل قوية ومستمرة معهم. تحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة من قبل الإدارة. إعداد تقارير دورية ومختصرة عن الزيارات الميدانية وفرص البيع المحتملة. التنسيق المستمر مع الإدارة وفريق التشغيل لمتابعة طلبات العملاء وضمان تنفيذها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المبيعات، ويفضل أن تكون في قطاع الخدمات أو توفير القوى العاملة. القدرة على البحث عن عملاء جدد وتطوير فرص عمل. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والعرض والتفاوض. القدرة على إعداد عروض الأسعار ومتابعتها بفعالية. الالتزام بتحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التفرغ للعمل في مقر الشركة بالرياض. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي المبيعات ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي في شركة تيرا سيرفيسز، ويتطلب الدور التنسيق المستمر مع الإدارة وفريق التشغيل لضمان تقديم أفضل الخدمات للعملاء. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عملنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم للنظر فيها.

45544b3a643fbeb6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث عيادات ياسمين الحياة عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقها في حائل. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان، ووضع الخطط العلاجية، وإجراء المعالجات السنية المختلفة، بالإضافة إلى متابعة تركيبات الأسنان وجراحات الفم الصغرى. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحص الشامل لأسنان المرضى، وتحديد الصور الشعاعية اللازمة، وتحليلها لتشخيص حالات الفم والأسنان بدقة. إعداد خطط العلاج وبرامجها الزمنية بما يتناسب مع كل حالة مرضية. تجهيز وتطبيق الحشوات السنية، ومعالجة القنوات اللبية للأسنان. تنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية. تحديد احتياجات المريض من التعويضات السنية، وأخذ القياسات اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها، ومعالجة التهابات اللثة المختلفة. إجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى ووصف العلاجات والأدوية المناسبة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال طب الأسنان. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المتبعة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال طب وصحة الأسنان. المؤهلات والخبرة درجة البكالوريوس في طب الأسنان أو ما يعادلها. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال طب الأسنان العام. القدرة على تشخيص وعلاج مجموعة واسعة من أمراض الفم والأسنان. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تشخيصية وعلاجية ممتازة. القدرة على إعداد خطط علاجية متكاملة. مهارات تواصل فعالة مع المرضى والزملاء. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والنظافة المهنية. نوع العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في مدينة حائل. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

The company partners with clients to address complex challenges and build infrastructure for future generations. With a global team of over 50,000 professionals, AECOM delivers tangible impact worldwide. Role Overview AECOM is seeking an Electrical Inspector to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Demonstrated understanding of Saudi electrical codes, SASO standards, and international safety regulations. Proficiency in analyzing electrical drawings, plans, and specifications. Experience with electrical testing equipment and diagnostic tools. Location This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is based in Al Jubail, Eastern region, and requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing project planning, governance, delivery execution, and go-live readiness, ensuring effective coordination among all stakeholders. Role Context and Expectations This role requires a strong understanding of SAP implementation and delivery lifecycles, including requirements management, solution design, testing, data migration, cutover, go-live, and post-implementation stabilization. The ideal candidate will combine structured project management capabilities with practical experience in delivering SAP ECC or SAP S/4HANA projects, managing multiple workstreams, and driving delivery within agreed scope, timelines, budget, and quality standards. Key Responsibilities Lead SAP project planning and governance, including project charters, work breakdown structures, integrated schedules, budgets, resource plans, milestones, and workstream responsibilities. Coordinate SAP functional teams, ABAP/Fiori developers, Basis and security teams, integration specialists, data teams, testing teams, business process owners, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and implementation partners. Manage requirements, fit-to-standard outcomes, process designs, functional and technical specifications, integrations, custom developments, roles, data objects, and requirements traceability. Control release scope, sprint and deployment plans, system environments, transports, dependencies, defects, and configuration/development readiness. Plan and govern System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), regression testing, performance testing, security testing, and data reconciliation. Manage data migration activities, mock loads, reconciliation, cutover planning, interface freezes, rollback arrangements, go-live command centers, and stabilization. Monitor implementation partner deliverables, estimates, change requests, acceptance criteria, commercial milestones, and knowledge transfer. Maintain risk, assumption, issue, and dependency (RAID) logs, decision registers, action trackers, change controls, quality findings, and approval records. Prepare project dashboards, weekly status reports, steering committee presentations, release-readiness updates, and executive decision papers. Coordinate user training, change communications, operational handover, hypercare, transition to application maintenance and support teams, project closure, and benefits tracking. Measures of Success SAP projects and releases delivered against approved scope, timelines, and quality criteria. Clear governance, accurate project reporting, and effective management of risks and dependencies. Controlled testing, data migration, cutover, and go-live activities. Successful transition to operational support, with complete documentation and knowledge transfer.

45681ea9dfd472b3.description: We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Procurement and Inventory Officer to manage purchasing activities and maintain accurate inventory records. This role is responsible for sourcing approved, high-quality materials at competitive prices, coordinating with suppliers, and ensuring that stock is available when needed. Success in this position means achieving cost-effective purchasing, maintaining optimal stock levels, ensuring timely delivery, and building strong relationships with reliable suppliers. The role supports the organization’s overall operational efficiency by preventing shortages, reducing unnecessary costs, and ensuring materials meet required standards. Responsibilities Research, evaluate, and select reliable suppliers. Request and compare quotations to secure the best prices, quality, and delivery terms. Verify that purchased materials meet required specifications, quality standards, and approvals. Negotiate prices, payment terms, contracts, and delivery schedules with suppliers. Prepare purchase orders and follow up until materials are delivered. Inspect received materials and match them against purchase orders and delivery documents. Monitor inventory levels and maintain accurate records of stock movements. Maintain minimum and maximum stock levels to prevent shortages and overstocking. Coordinate with internal departments to understand purchasing and inventory requirements. Maintain an updated database of suppliers, prices, products, and purchasing records. Prepare regular reports on purchasing activities, inventory levels, costs, and supplier performance. Identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve procurement and inventory processes. Resolve supplier, delivery, quality, and invoice-related issues professionally and promptly. Qualifications Previous experience in procurement, purchasing, supply chain, or inventory management. Strong research, sourcing, negotiation, and supplier-management skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Good knowledge of inventory-control procedures and purchasing practices. Ability to assess material quality and confirm compliance with required specifications. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. Experience using inventory-management or ERP systems is preferred. Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Logistics, or a related field is preferred. Fluency in English is preferred; knowledge of Arabic is an advantage.

451fdb7301ceefda.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الخدمات البحرية عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة العمليات المالية اليومية، بما في ذلك إعداد المستندات المحاسبية وتتبع الإيرادات والنفقات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى المحاسب مسؤولية مجموعة من المهام المالية والإدارية لضمان دقة السجلات المحاسبية والامتثال للإجراءات المعتمدة. تشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف، ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. متابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها بشكل دوري. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات المخصصة. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بما يتوافق مع الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات. المهام التفصيلية بالإضافة إلى المسؤوليات الرئيسية، سيقوم المحاسب بتنفيذ مهام محددة لضمان سير العمليات المالية بكفاءة ودقة: تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من اكتمال شروطها القانونية والمالية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في هذا المجال. ضمان حفظ جميع الوثائق والتقارير المالية بشكل منظم ويمكن الوصول إليه. المؤهلات والخبرة لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية بدقة. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ المحاسبة وإعداد القيود والتسويات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق مالي لدعم العمليات التشغيلية لشركة الخدمات البحرية. التقديم نرحب بالمرشحين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقدم لهذه الفرصة.

4520426821df92db.description: About the Role Bupa Arabia is seeking a Technician Audiology to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is crucial in supporting audiologists and other healthcare professionals in the assessment, diagnosis, and management of patients with hearing and balance disorders. The position requires specialized knowledge of audiology procedures, technical competence, strong communication skills, and a patient-centered approach to care, with 0-1 years of experience required. Key Responsibilities Conduct and assist with audiological diagnostic procedures such as pure-tone audiometry, tympanometry, otoacoustic emissions (OAE), hearing screenings, speech audiometry, and other audiological assessments according to established protocols. Prepare patients for hearing assessments, explain testing procedures, and ensure patient comfort and cooperation. Assist audiologists during specialized assessments and hearing aid evaluations. Ensure proper patient positioning and testing environment. Assess patient educational needs and coordinate with relevant departments as needed. Educate patients and families regarding hearing disorders, diagnostic procedures, hearing conservation, hearing aids, and treatment plans as directed by the audiologist. Provide emotional support and reassurance throughout the patient journey and ensure patients understand follow-up instructions and recommendations. Collaboration and Documentation Collaborate closely with physicians, nurses, speech therapists, and other healthcare professionals to coordinate patient care. Maintain effective communication with team members regarding patient status, test results, and service requirements. Facilitate smooth patient flow and continuity of care. Accurately document audiological test results, patient information, interventions, and observations within Electronic Medical Records (EMR). Maintain complete and accurate audiology records, ensuring compliance with documentation standards, legal requirements, and departmental policies. Maintain patient confidentiality at all times. Quality and Compliance Ensure audiology equipment is cleaned, calibrated, maintained, and ready for use according to manufacturer recommendations and departmental standards. Adhere to infection prevention and control standards. Identify and report equipment malfunctions, safety concerns, and environmental hazards. Comply with organizational policies, accreditation standards, and regulatory requirements. Participate in quality improvement initiatives and patient safety programs. Assist supervisors with additional work-related responsibilities within the scope of practice. Professional Development Stay current with advances in audiology technology, hearing assessment techniques, hearing devices, and patient care practices. Participate in continuing education, workshops, seminars, and professional development activities. Demonstrate and maintain competence in all mandatory competencies. Maintain current licensure, certifications, and professional requirements for the position. Work Environment The work environment may involve standing for long periods, lifting/moving equipment, and interacting with patients in various states of health. Flexibility in scheduling may be required to accommodate patient appointments and department needs.

45814d0cb8241be6.description: About Petro Rabigh Petro Rabigh is a leading producer of fuels and plastics essential for modern life. The company's refined products are crucial for the transport industry, while its petrochemicals are utilized across various sectors, including food packaging, clothing, construction materials, medical supplies, and computer components. By enhancing the value of national resources, Petro Rabigh aims to attract diverse new industries, create employment opportunities, and foster sustainable economic and social development. Role Overview: Lead Technician The Lead Technician role at Petro Rabigh in Rabigh is a full-time position requiring extensive experience in maintenance. This role focuses on ensuring the reliable operation of electrical power systems across all facilities. Key responsibilities include troubleshooting, testing and commissioning, repairing defects, and identifying alternative solutions to maintain system functionality. The scope of work covers a wide range of electrical equipment, such as LV/HV switchgear, protection systems, SF6 Gas handling, VFD, UPS, battery chargers, battery banks, power cables, transformers and their oil, motors, MOVs, generators, and heaters. Key Responsibilities Diagnose equipment, locate faulty components, determine necessary repairs, and identify required spare parts for effective work planning. Execute all preventive and predictive maintenance programs for electrical equipment, including thermography, transformer oil analysis, and partial discharge testing. Assist in monitoring, facilitating, and controlling contractor works under OPEX/Service Contracts. Lead Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA) and drive the implementation of corrective and preventive actions. Evaluate and identify potential improvement opportunities to enhance the reliability of electrical equipment and plant operations. Recommend new modifications to improve existing facilities, striving for continuous improvement and suggesting innovative ideas for better results. Develop and deliver technical reports, lessons learned sessions, and technical analyses to department management as required. Provide training on various technical topics and generate guidelines for using electrical testing equipment, delivering necessary training classes. Perform electrical equipment testing for breakers, transformers, cables, and motors. Follow all PRC safety standards and guidelines. Required Skills and Experience Proficiency in VFD software tools for programming, configuration, and diagnostics across various types such as TMEIC, Toshiba, ABB, and Siemens. Experience with UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) equipment, including successful troubleshooting and repairs. Experience with Protective Relaying Systems, Electric Metering/Measuring Devices, Intelligent Electrical Devices (IEDs), and Power Monitoring and Control systems. This includes the ability to download protection settings, evaluate settings and events, test all protection functions, and safely upload protection settings. High experience in diagnostics and repair methods for electrical equipment within refining and petrochemical industries. High experience in international maintenance standards and best practices. Qualifications and Attributes Diploma in Electrical Discipline. 5-10 years of relevant experience. The Sales team aims to drive revenue while acting as trusted consultants to customers, specializing in account management, business development, and customer service. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. Role Overview: Customer Solutions Consultant As a Customer Solutions Consultant, you will enable customers to achieve digital transformation through cloud communication. This involves leading collaboration with a virtual team comprising sales, engineering, and support resources. Key responsibilities include building and maintaining strong customer relationships, influencing long-term strategic direction, serving as a trusted advisor, and engaging with CXOs and technology decision-makers. You will assist customers in evaluating their cloud communication strategy, recommending solutions aligned with their business and technical requirements, addressing deployment challenges, and ensuring successful adoption to drive customer satisfaction. Key Responsibilities Act as a technical liaison between Sales and Product teams during the sales process, supporting solution design, quotes, proposals, RFP responses, and related documentation. Develop working knowledge of Unifonic's conversational AI and omnichannel communications platform. Participate in Sales team meetings to understand customer pain points, requirements, and business goals, and help shape relevant solutions. Support problem escalation and best-practice efforts to assist clients and internal teams in using Unifonic's products effectively. Build and deliver product demonstrations and pilots that showcase Unifonic's value to prospects and clients. Relay timely, organized client feedback to Product Management, Sales, Support, and Development based on real business cases. Ensure a clear handover of won deals to the Customer Success team, providing context on customer goals and configuration. Support Sales and Account Management on upsell and cross-sell opportunities with technical input. Coordinate with cross-functional teams (Product, Support, Engineering) as needed to close deals. Qualifications and Requirements Ability to create a positive customer experience by matching appropriate product/service offerings to their needs. Ability to understand and troubleshoot customer needs, translating them into workable solutions. Strong interpersonal skills, with comfort in engaging multiple stakeholders and collaborating with virtual/cross-functional teams. A minimum of 2-5 years of relevant experience is required for this role. Required Character Traits Analytical thinking and problem-solving: approaching problems clearly, utilizing data, and identifying solutions. Ownership and accountability: taking responsibility and ensuring project completion. Communication: explaining ideas clearly and actively listening across teams. Collaboration: working effectively with others and supporting team goals. Adaptability and learning: adjusting to change and continuously acquiring new skills or tools. Mentorship and knowledge sharing: supporting the growth of others and sharing expertise. Resilience: maintaining composure under pressure and handling setbacks constructively. Quality and attention to detail: performing work carefully and striving for continuous improvement. Advocacy and innovation: encouraging best practices, efficiency, and new ideas.

45e2187d7c2d7ad8.description: About the Role Mace Group is seeking an experienced Senior Quality Manager for a part-time position. This role involves delivering quality excellence on major infrastructure, civil, utilities, industrial, and building developments. The Senior Quality Manager will act on behalf of the Client and PMO within a PMC environment, ensuring contractors, consultants, and suppliers comply with contractual requirements, project specifications, applicable standards, and regulatory requirements. Role Overview Reporting directly to the QA/QC Director, the Senior Quality Manager will lead site quality teams, drive quality assurance initiatives, and manage inspections and audits. Key responsibilities include resolving non-conformances and promoting continuous improvement across all project phases, from design through commissioning and handover. This position requires a professional with extensive experience in Quality Assurance and Quality Control. Key Responsibilities Implement and maintain project quality management requirements and objectives. Monitor contractor compliance with approved Quality Management Systems (QMS), ITPs, procedures, and specifications. Lead quality audits, inspections, surveillance activities, and compliance assessments. Manage NCRs, corrective actions, preventive actions, and lessons learned processes. Review and approve quality documentation, method statements, testing records, and close-out dossiers. Coordinate quality requirements across engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities. Develop quality performance reports and KPI dashboards for project leadership, PMO, and Client stakeholders. Support testing, commissioning, handover, and operational readiness activities. Promote a culture of quality excellence, continuous improvement, and right-first-time delivery. Champion a safety-first culture and values-led quality leadership. Direct quality management systems, audits, inspections, and compliance assurance. Drive quality risk management, defect resolution, and continuous improvement. Supervise quality assurance programmes, audits, certification, and management system governance. Provide strategic quality advice, risk mitigation, and performance reporting to senior stakeholders. Develop team capability through leadership, training, and continuous improvement initiatives. Drive stakeholder collaboration, supply chain assurance, and sustainability-focused delivery outcomes. Company Values Mace Group operates on a foundation of core values that guide its operations and employee conduct: Safety first: Championing a safe, diverse, and inclusive working environment, with an understanding of well-being. Client focus: Delivering on promises by owning the quality of deliverables and strategic outcomes, and building long-term client relationships. Integrity: Always doing the right thing, influencing positive outcomes within the industry while aligning with compliance obligations. Create opportunity: Fostering a continuous improvement culture throughout all activities, inspiring people and teams to develop. Application Information Mace is an inclusive employer and welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. Applicants are encouraged to apply even if they do not meet all criteria, as they may still be suitable for this or another role within the organisation. The company is open to discussing part-time, flexible, and hybrid working options where suitable for the role.

4502fbe669e1598b.description: About the Role Golden Stations - Events & Conferences Company is seeking a Visual Effects Producer to join their team in Dammam, Eastern region. This full-time role requires a professional with a strong background in visual effects, post-production, motion graphics, and digital content production. The ideal candidate will have experience working on corporate, event, promotional, and commercial projects. Key Responsibilities Plan, manage, and deliver VFX projects from concept through to final production. Create and oversee visual effects, motion graphics, compositing, and animations. Collaborate with creative, video, and production teams to develop visual concepts. Manage VFX workflows, timelines, resources, and project deliverables. Review and ensure the quality of all visual effects and post-production work. Support corporate events, exhibitions, marketing campaigns, social media, and promotional content with high-quality visual effects. Ensure all final content meets professional quality standards and project deadlines. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in VFX production. Strong knowledge of visual effects and post-production workflows. Proficiency in Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, and DaVinci Resolve. Strong understanding of motion graphics, compositing, animation, and visual effects. Experience with 3D/VFX production and CGI is an advantage. Strong understanding of color grading, compositing, and post-production techniques. Proven track record of producing high-quality professional VFX and visual content. Required Skills Strong creative and technical understanding of visual storytelling. Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines. Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply by submitting their CV along with their portfolio or showreel.

451e9a409d1da411.job_title: QA/QC Civil Engineer (Saudi Energy Approval Preferred)
451e9a409d1da411.description: About Alfanar Projects Alfanar Projects, headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, operates construction and manufacturing businesses, design and development centers, and various facilities across the Middle East and other countries. The company is involved in Electrical, Electromechanical, and Civil Engineering Construction, manufacturing and marketing electrical construction products, and allied engineering services. Alfanar Construction is classified as a Grade I contractor by the Contractors Classification Committee of the Government of Saudi Arabia, with a strong track record as an Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) contractor in the Energy, Infrastructure, and Engineering Services sectors. Job Summary Alfanar Projects is seeking a QA/QC Civil Engineer to join their team in Dammam. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of experience and is responsible for performing project civil Quality Control and Quality Assurance activities. The role ensures efficient and timely execution of tasks to meet quality standards, aligning with defined policies and procedures to achieve departmental operational plans and developments. Key Responsibilities Implement the Quality Management System (QMS) and coordinate project quality inspection activities with clients, consultants, and vendors. Maintain system manuals, international and national standards, client specifications, technical data sheets, and all relevant inspection documents. Verify accreditations, certifications, and approvals of vendors and third-party agencies. Maintain quality records, including logbooks, QA/QC weekly reports, internal inspection reports, and Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs). Prepare quality-related documents such as Inspection and Test Plans (ITP), Method of Statements (MOS), Checklists, and QA/QC weekly reports. Implement the ALFANAR LESSON LEARNT PROGRAM to reduce punch points during project handover and ensure customer satisfaction. Ensure works are carried out according to Project Technical Specifications (PTS), Issued For Construction (IFC) drawings, and approved method statements. Confirm that works are properly inspected at required stages as per ITP or client requirements. Verify that all materials and equipment comply with contract specifications, plans, PTS, and standards. Conduct site installation inspections and material receiving inspections, reporting to the concerned authority. Control and monitor inspection and test requirements and data, assuring the maintenance and calibration of inspection testing equipment. Coordinate with the Execution Team, Project Management, Client, and Consultant on QC matters. Coordinate with independent testing laboratories for material testing, follow up on reports, and submit to the consultant. Provide quality reporting to the Total Quality Management (TQM) Department. Report quality-related matters to the Project Manager for action and to the TQM Manager for information. Obtain, verify, and maintain traceable quality records, including a proper log for QC documents. Verify test results, reporting, and recommendations to the Project Manager for necessary actions. Role Accountabilities Train subordinates and foster teamwork to achieve work effectively. Provide leadership, coaching, and direction to subordinates in all aspects of their work. Perform planned activities to meet operational and development targets as per delivery schedules. Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time. Resolve operational problems and escalate complex issues as needed. Ensure quality requirements are met to develop effective quality control and processes. Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automation opportunities. Comply with relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience. Strong understanding of Quality Management Systems (QMS) and project quality standards. Ability to prepare and maintain quality documentation and reports. Experience in site inspections, material verification, and testing. Proficiency in coordinating with various stakeholders, including clients, consultants, and internal teams. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Dammam.

45284bb0de47b390.description: About Alcon Alcon is a global leader in eye care, committed to improving lives through its industry-leading products and technologies. The company focuses on innovation and collaboration to help people achieve brilliant vision. The Role Alcon is seeking a Sr. Associate, Logistics & Freight Management to support transportation, customs compliance, and distribution activities for its Saudi Distribution Center. This full-time position is based in Jiddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. The role involves coordinating inbound and outbound shipments, customs clearance, logistics service providers, and distribution operations to ensure timely, compliant, and efficient product delivery across Saudi Arabia. Additionally, the Sr. Associate will support transportation projects across the GEM region, particularly in the Middle East and North Africa. Key Responsibilities Coordinate inbound and outbound transportation activities and monitor shipment execution. Manage customs clearance documentation and serve as the primary contact with customs authorities using FASAH/ZATCA. Collaborate with freight forwarders, customs brokers, carriers, and warehouse teams to maintain operational continuity. Support NUPCO shipment processes, including ASN bookings and Goods Receipt Management. Track deliveries, resolve logistics issues, and manage customer-specific distribution requirements. Review freight invoices, validate costs, and address discrepancies. Ensure compliance with GxP regulations, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and quality standards. Identify operational improvement opportunities and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. Required Experience 2-5 years of experience in logistics and freight management. Work Environment This role operates within a dynamic and collaborative environment dedicated to eye care. Alcon is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace for all associates. Application Information Salary for this position will not be disclosed.

45623e77b338a462.description: About Keeta Keeta, an international subsidiary of Meituan, focuses on food and consumer product delivery. The company, established in 2023, leverages Meituan's 16 years of technological and operational expertise to create value for consumers, restaurants, and courier partners. Keeta operates in Hong Kong, China, across the Middle East, and in Brazil, with a mission to help people eat better and live better. The Role of Category Manager Keeta is seeking a Category Manager to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves shaping the grocery and quick-commerce market by managing category structure, assortment, pricing, and promotions. The position offers an opportunity to contribute to a growing platform and collaborate with regional and international teams. Key Responsibilities Plan the category structure and define the essential SKU list to ensure assortment breadth and depth. Drive online assortment with merchants and guide merchant expansion decisions through demand-supply matching analysis. Own the pricing strategy and competitiveness framework to strengthen category performance. Design and execute promotion plans, analyzing market trends and consumer preferences to enhance selection and campaign effectiveness. Set and enforce listing standards, monitoring pricing accuracy and inventory availability to ensure content and data quality. Partner with Account Managers to deliver merchant-side operation suggestions and feed optimization input into user-facing channels. Work Environment and Growth This role provides an opportunity for ground-floor impact within a fast-growing platform. The Category Manager will collaborate with regional and international teams while building for the local market in Saudi Arabia. The position offers opportunities to deepen skills and explore innovation in category management within a dynamic and diverse team environment. Company Culture and Impact Keeta is focused on global expansion, aiming to deliver impact for its people, partners, and communities. The company emphasizes growth, local innovation, and adapting to evolving markets. Employees are encouraged to develop a global mindset and local expertise, working on projects that challenge them to create solutions that resonate worldwide. Keeta fosters a collaborative environment where open debate and diverse perspectives are valued to drive progress and efficiency.

45913c943775a0f4.description: About Panasonic Avionics Corporation Panasonic Avionics Corporation is a leading provider of inflight entertainment and connectivity products, including movies, games, WiFi, and Bluetooth headphone connectivity. With over 40 years in the industry, the company offers stability and career growth opportunities within a diverse and inclusive culture. Role Overview: Customer Support Field Engineer IV The Customer Support Field Engineer IV serves as an on-site support liaison between Panasonic and airline customers in Makkah and Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves ensuring customer satisfaction and optimal performance of Panasonic equipment. The engineer provides service, technical guidance, support, and training to airline customers to meet product performance and reliability objectives. This position requires 5-10 years of experience and involves representing Panasonic Field Engineering interests in resolving technical issues with other Panasonic and customer engineering departments, as well as providing complex technical guidance to junior engineers and managing large projects. Key Responsibilities Provide advanced technical guidance and field assistance to Panasonic personnel and airline customers for troubleshooting and resolving system hardware, network, and software issues. Perform complex troubleshooting and problem-solving for new equipment installations, enhancements, or modifications, working with engineering departments to ensure timely corrective action. Review mechanical, electrical, and software installation documentation to verify specifications are met. Collaborate with the training department to conduct operational, line, and maintenance training for airline customers. Assist in aircraft delivery and provide support during flight tests and customer flight acceptance. Participate in resolving system operation, maintenance, or reliability issues by conducting investigations and collecting data. Provide field inputs to other Panasonic departments regarding technical product issues, installation, or documentation problems. Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of Panasonic products and installations, including system software and associated equipment. Provide regular, accurate, and detailed technical reports to Field Engineering management and relevant departments. Manage relationships between Panasonic and assigned customers to ensure satisfaction and long-term business relationships. Provide mentoring and guidance to less experienced team members. Required Qualifications and Skills Ability to assist with technical issues impacting multiple airline programs. Advanced working knowledge of aircraft systems that interface with Panasonic Avionics Corp equipment. Advanced understanding and utilization of wiring schematics, diagrams, and other engineering/aircraft documentation. Extensive knowledge of multiple Panasonic Avionics Corp product lines and/or system types. Proficiency in identifying and communicating complex engineering problems in software and hardware to Field Engineering Management. Advanced engineering-level product knowledge in avionics and related software areas. Proficient using MS Office suite of products. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Effective interpersonal, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Advanced ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and prioritize responsibilities with minimum supervision. Demonstrated ability to lead teams and perform as a technical expert. Highly proficient in project planning, addressing external/internal dependencies across multiple functions. Proven ability to extensively modify existing processes, procedures, or methods to develop appropriate solutions. Demonstrable experience providing identifiable technical contributions to the success of a product or project. Proven ability to develop technical approaches, resource allocation, or time schedules for projects. Ability to effectively interact with senior internal and external personnel. Additional Requirements Must hold a valid driver’s license and meet airport authority requirements for access and vehicle operation. Ability to travel up to 50%, both domestic and international, often on short notice. Ability and willingness to provide weekend and after-hours support as required. Able to obtain Airport Security access, which may require passing a Criminal Records check and Drugs/Alcohol test.

459cb84ac63b6725.description: About GEN PLUS Group GEN PLUS Group is a global collective of agencies focused on delivering impactful outcomes through creativity, innovation, and integration. The group's ecosystem includes PRM, NaF+, SPANDY, and THEM AGAIN, supported by GEN+, a team of over 3,000 experts from more than 60 nationalities. The company aims to create meaningful connections for brands, businesses, and individuals globally. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves developing and executing comprehensive social media programs. The role requires 5-10 years of experience in social media, including team leadership. Key Responsibilities Provide senior-level strategic counsel to clients and internal teams, promoting innovation and integrated communications. Lead the development of integrated Social, PR, and Influencer strategies aligned with business objectives, brand positioning, media narratives, and audience insights. Drive the creation and execution of social, PR, and influencer-led campaigns that enhance brand relevance, cultural resonance, and earned media impact. Build and maintain relationships with media, influencers, and key opinion leaders to amplify brand stories and enhance credibility. Oversee influencer identification, engagement, contracting, and performance management to ensure authentic partnerships. Shape brand narratives and storytelling frameworks for seamless translation across social media, press coverage, thought leadership, and influencer collaborations. Lead product launches, brand announcements, and reputation management initiatives in collaboration with PR and social teams. Ensure all content, press materials, influencer collaborations, and creative assets adhere to brand standards while delivering consistent storytelling. Partner with creative, media, and client leadership teams to ensure integrated campaign alignment and strategic coherence. Stay informed on emerging trends, platform shifts, media landscapes, and influencer ecosystems to maintain a competitive edge. Deep knowledge of major social media platforms (Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn). Experience with social management tools. Skills Fluency in Arabic and strong communication skills. Strong writing, storytelling, and organizational skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a global collective of agencies.

45a7c04a98d5bc0a.description: About Jaadin Contracting & Consulting Jaadin Contracting & Consulting is a multidisciplinary firm founded by engineering professionals with over 35 years of experience in the MENA region. The company provides integrated engineering and contracting services, focusing on delivering practical, high-quality solutions for complex projects. Jaadin supports clients across various sectors, including construction and infrastructure, within a professional environment that values technical excellence, reliability, and long-term client relationships. The Role of Fabrication Supervisor The Fabrication Supervisor is a full-time, on-site position based in Riyadh. This role is responsible for overseeing daily fabrication operations, whether in the workshop or on a project site. The supervisor coordinates production schedules, assigns tasks to fabrication teams, and monitors workflow to ensure projects are completed on time and according to specifications. Key Responsibilities Oversee daily fabrication operations in the workshop or on project sites. Coordinate production schedules and assign tasks to fabrication teams. Monitor workflow to ensure projects are completed on time and in line with specifications. Enforce quality and safety standards. Inspect welding and fabrication work to ensure compliance with relevant codes and procedures. Guide and support technicians, including organizing training on fabrication methods and equipment. Collaborate with engineering and project management teams to resolve technical issues. Maintain documentation related to production, quality control, and resource utilization for continuous improvement. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in fabrication supervision or a related field. Demonstrated ability to manage and coordinate fabrication teams effectively. Strong understanding of quality and safety standards in fabrication. Proficiency in inspecting welding and fabrication work. Knowledge of relevant industry codes and procedures. Skills and Attributes Strong leadership and team guidance capabilities. Excellent problem-solving skills for technical issues. Attention to detail in quality control and documentation. Effective communication and collaboration skills with engineering and project management teams. 45bb48db29474267.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة ماجد القرشي التجارية عن مشرف مطعم للانضمام إلى فريقها في مدينة الطائف. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف على العمليات اليومية للمطعم، مع التركيز بشكل خاص على المطاعم الشعبية. يتطلب الدور خبرة إشرافية سابقة لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف المباشر على جميع جوانب تشغيل المطعم لضمان تقديم خدمة عالية الجودة. مراقبة أداء الموظفين وتوجيههم لتحقيق الأهداف التشغيلية. ضمان الالتزام بمعايير النظافة والسلامة الغذائية داخل المطعم. التعامل مع أي مشكلات تشغيلية أو تحديات قد تطرأ بفعالية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة إشرافية سابقة في مجال المطاعم، مع تفضيل الخبرة في المطاعم الشعبية. تتراوح الخبرة المطلوبة بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. إقامة سارية المفعول لمدة لا تقل عن 6 أشهر. تفاصيل الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتقع في مدينة الطائف. الراتب الشهري لهذا الدور يتراوح بين 0 و 1,875 ريال سعودي. بيئة العمل سيعمل مشرف المطعم ضمن فريق مؤسسة ماجد القرشي التجارية، حيث يتولى مسؤولية الإشراف على العمليات اليومية في بيئة مطعم ديناميكية، مع التركيز على تقديم تجربة مميزة للعملاء. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المرشحين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه لتقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور في مؤسسة ماجد القرشي التجارية.

45c225e76933b496.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رائدة في المنطقة الشرقية عن موظف مبيعات وتسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى استقطاب العملاء وتطوير العلاقات المهنية، بالإضافة إلى الترويج لمنتجات وخدمات الشركة وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. يشمل النطاق الجغرافي للدور مدن الدمام، الخبر، الظهران، الجبيل، الأحساء، الهفوف، بقيق، راس تنورة، الخفجي، قرية العليا، النعيرية، صفوى، القطيف، سيهات، تاروت، الجش، عنك، دارين، أم الحمام، جواثا، المبرز، العمران، والجفر. الهدف من الوظيفة يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية رئيسية في تنمية الأعمال من خلال استقطاب العملاء الجدد وبناء علاقات قوية معهم. كما يساهم في تنفيذ الأنشطة التسويقية التي تدعم نمو الشركة وتوسع قاعدة عملائها، مع التركيز على تحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات تطوير مبيعات B2B في مجال خدمات الموارد البشرية. استقطاب العملاء من قطاع الأعمال وبناء علاقات مهنية مستدامة معهم. الترويج لخدمات الشركة بفعالية وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. متابعة فرص البيع المحتملة حتى إتمام التعاقد بنجاح. المساهمة في تنمية قاعدة العملاء وتوسيع نطاق الأعمال. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات والتسويق. القدرة على استقطاب العملاء وتطوير العلاقات المهنية. مهارات قوية في التفاوض وإتمام الصفقات. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في المنطقة الشرقية بالمملكة العربية السعودية. ستعمل ضمن فريق ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتوسيع نطاق أعمال الشركة في قطاع خدمات الموارد البشرية. معلومات إضافية اسم الشركة محجوب من قبل صاحب العمل، وسيتم الكشف عنه للمرشحين المؤهلين. الراتب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

SAP-PM Management: Oversee the lifecycle of work orders within SAP, ensuring accurate data capture for maintenance history and spare parts inventory. Utility Expertise: Proven track record maintaining utility-specific equipment (Boilers, RO Plants, Steam Turbines, and Air Compressors). RCA Mastery: Demonstrated experience leading Root Cause Analysis and implementing technical solutions in a high-pressure environment. Software Skills: Proficiency in SAP (Plant Maintenance module) and engineering design software (AutoCAD). Standards Knowledge: Deep familiarity with API and ASME codes relevant to refinery utilities.
